beats.narration: Airport security has two different checks.
beats.on_screen: Illustration: an airport. A boarding pass check, then an X-ray belt.

beats.narration: The boarding pass says where you are allowed to go.
The X-ray says what is in your bag. A valid ticket does not carry a prohibited item through.
beats.on_screen: A bag on the X-ray with a prohibited item. It is pulled aside.

beats.narration: An agent moves data through four channels. A synthetic SSN and card number are planted in them.
beats.on_screen: The lab, scenario 17. Four channels: prompt, retrieved chunk, tool result, model answer.

beats.narration: With no data guard, the restricted data crosses every hop.
beats.on_screen: **Run the attack** in vulnerable mode. Each hop forwards the raw data.

beats.narration: In secure mode a scanner inspects the payload on every hop: restricted data is blocked, email addresses are masked.
beats.on_screen: Switch to **Secure**, run. `DATA` before, `DEFENSE` C21 scan_data BLOCK, `DATA` after `[SSN]`. Caption: "Contained at USER".

beats.narration: The Forensics tab shows the before and after for each channel.
beats.on_screen: Open the **Forensics** tab: before and after per channel.

beats.narration: The lab's X-ray is a set of patterns for SSNs and card numbers. Real data in unusual formats can slip past pattern matching.
